All persons whom interested in the aforesaid lands/ servitudes already acquired, are hereby required to appear personally, or through an agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Kurunegala the day of 30.12.2019, the nature of their claims for compensation for the said lands/ Servitude, the amount of compensation and Computation of compensation of such amount, Further the person should appear for an inquiry under Section 09 of the act Commence from 14.01.2020 on wards. The date of inquiry and the relevant documents to be submitted at the inquiry such as deeds may duly informed by me.
If an agent may present at the inquiry, Original claimant of the land must be duly authorized in writing. Without
such a letter statement or evidence may not be recorded from such an agent.
E. M. M. S. EKANAYAKE, Divisional Secretary and Land Acquiring Officer, Kurunegala. Divisional Secretariat, Kurunegala.
